annotations.title: Accept or decline an introduction request

description: Accept or decline an introduction request that is waiting on the user (status pending in list_matches). Accepting opens a chat with the other member. Declining is private; the requester is not notified and requests expire on their own after 30 days. Confirm with the user before declining.
